notes.title: Skulltide Update 2.0 !
notes.notes:
Skulltide is joining the wizards at the Wonders of Wizardry sale event this year with a brand new update, featuring a host of bugfixes and a massive performance overhaul. Lessons from the third game in the Planar Danse, The Fool's Apprentice, have been brought back to Skulltide, and the game performs with overall 60% less GPU usage in all complex levels. 



In my tests, the levels of Tel Sora and Zypressvald stressed streaming and rendering the most, and now frametimes have halved, doubling FPS in these levels! The game overall has a massive increase in performance on GPU and CPU, as tweaks to 💀enemy AI💀 allowed for more intelligent use of resources. As such, the minimum specs for Skulltide have been slightly lowered :)



If you've been hesitant to delve into Skulltide, the game is now better than ever, and currently on discount through the event! Several rare but run-demolishing bugs have been quashed, and a little spot of necromancy might just be the spell you need this year for the Wonders of Wizardry! 🧙🧙🧙



Click here to see the full roster of games included in the Wonders of Wizardry event, hosted by the developer of Skulltide and the other games and novels in the universe. 106 games, including 60+ currently on discount!

Wonders of Wizardry 2025 Event



Thanks for reading, I hope you enjoy Skulltide :)

K.S. Morii, TPD.

notes.title: Skulltide Full Release!
notes.notes:
Skulltide comes now with its largest update, bringing it into a state of full release! This skeletal adventure game has been a blast to create, and thank you to all those who have followed along with it until now! A few more updates shall come to Skulltide, and to The Planar Danse overall--Read on for a big update to the next project!


New Ability Set

Skulltide has received a big new update! Get the Knights Adamant ability set, comprised of:

Sanctify - adds a weapon buff for source/entropic damage that does pure damage to those whose soul is necromantically aligned. Dont hit your friends)
Blade of the Diamond - A slower two-handed sword with wider swings and high damage.
Riposte - Ever wanted to parry those pesty knights? Now you can!
Battle Totem - Raise an explosive totem to provide buffs to nearby skeletons! It also explodes!
Honorcall - A passive guard for you and all allies nearby, which can be toggled to provide massive Durability at the cost of speed.




2 New Levels

Also journey to two new levels, the Zypressvald, located in the Unsleeping Hollow of old Cospia, a cypress/pine wood caught in a heavy storm, with winding tree-paths; and Fel Scoria, the Magma Flats of Nocturne, a lava-ridden land of sinkholes and lava-boats.


Also check out the previous game in the Planar Danse for an occult narrative adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1472060/Apollyon_River_of_Life/


Published Novel in The Planar Danse

This is a story of fantasy/magical realism, a genre which takes the rules of the Planar Danse within their own logic and treats them as fact, exploring the reality of human experience around it. The theme is that of occultism and black magic in a land where such is not looked down upon, rather, interaction with the spiritual world is the norm. 

Spirit's Almanac, by K. S. Morii

In other lands the black magicks of occultism are hunted and burned at the stake; not so in Elysia. Here, spells are state mandates, spirits are firm allies, ghosts are kept instead of graves. None know this more than the agents of the Ministry, whose role is that of the use of and protection against the occult. One such name, Agent Yukiko, uses the hidden spirit world, the Twilight, to calm and catch rampant ghosts or devilish evils, alike. 

However, when the Twilight takes her in return, trapping her in wayward, timeless realms for 63 years, she returns with nary a connection to the Elysian Dynasty in the modern day. Her family passed, the world different, with war brewing and spirits inspired to violence. The Ministry, however, remains a steward of a precarious Dynasty under the rule of a drunkard Emperor given the title of Carnival Crown for his near-infinite debauchery and unending celebrations. It may not be the same Ministry she left behind in the world-before, but in order to keep the peace between the worlds of the physical and spiritual, she will need to navigate this black magic bureaucracy and play the part of witch and agent.
